title: Timed control configuration
statement: Given finite Boolean Turing machines $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$, an input string $x$, and a configuration $c$ of $D$ on $x$, define a configuration of the timed conditional machine on $x$. It embeds the state and configuration of $D$ into the machine's $D$ block, pads the work tapes belonging to $M_1$ and $M_2$ with blank tapes whose heads are at zero, and captures the output of $c$ on the extra tape; the resulting control state is the designated false control state.
hypotheses_covered: $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$ are finite Boolean Turing machines
